order_behavior.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE (bounded: most recent 200 executed orders; ALL canceled and resting orders)
order_behavior.reading: Every sampled real order was filled in full, as a taker, within 5 seconds of placement, including the 21 limit orders (marketable limits that crossed the spread). The account holds only 1 canceled and 0 resting orders in total. So there is no real-world evidence at all on how patient resting orders fill: no maker fills, no unfilled resting orders, and no queue behaviour have ever been observed. Real entry time equals placement time to within seconds, so an entry-quote capture needs a book snapshot from seconds before the order; a snapshot from minutes earlier is not the entry market.

series_fee_schedule.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE (exchange catalogue + exchange-reported fees; bounded sample)
series_fee_schedule.reading: Maker fees are series-specific: 10 of 39 series (game, spread and total markets for NFL, NCAAF, NBA, NCAAMB and WNBA) are published as quadratic_with_maker_fees, 28 as plain quadratic, and one as a combo-maker class. Observed taker fees match a 0.07 coefficient in every series, but 3 MLB series publish a 0.5 multiplier while their fills show 0.07, so the schedule changed over time; fee history by date has not yet been read. The maker coefficient itself remains unobserved (0 maker fills).

confidence: LOW: bounded samples; no verified recommendation links; no prospective entry quotes yet; no adequately powered execution advantage.
